kv.title: KV Store
kv.description: Browse all KV keys, lazily load visible values, and manage entries with admin-only safeguards.
kv.card_description: Browse and manage KV keys, values, and cache clearing controls
kv.clear_title: Clear the entire KV namespace and server cache?
kv.clear_description: This deletes every KV key and clears the server cache storage. It can remove feature flag cache data, auth challenges, decrypt tokens, and premium media cache entries.
kv.access_description: Values are loaded only for the current table page and cached in this browser session until reload. Temporary keys are flagged, but all keys remain editable. Saving a TTL-backed key may remove its expiration because TTL metadata is not exposed.
kv.empty_description: Create a key or reload the namespace.
kv.edit_description: Update the selected KV value. Use raw mode for plain text and JSON mode for structured values.
kv.create_description: Create a new KV key with either raw text or a JSON value.
kv.temporary_expiration: Saving this key may remove its expiration because TTL metadata is not exposed.
kv.key_hint: Keys can use any non-empty string up to Cloudflare KV's 512-byte key limit.
kv.mode_hint: Raw text saves exactly as typed. JSON mode parses the editor content before saving.
kv.value_hint: Existing non-string KV values are shown as formatted JSON. Existing raw strings that parse as JSON open in JSON mode.
kv.delete_title: Delete KV key? | Delete KV keys?
kv.delete_description: This will permanently delete {count} KV key. This action cannot be undone. | This will permanently delete {count} KV keys. This action cannot be undone.
kv.temporary_selection: Selection includes temporary or cache-sensitive keys
kv.temporary_delete_hint: Deleting these keys can interrupt active auth, decrypt, media, or cache flows. Editing TTL-backed keys can also make them permanent.
kv.save_failed: Failed to save the KV item
kv.load_values_failed: Failed to load visible KV values
kv.load_selected_failed: Failed to load the selected KV value
kv.delete_limit: Select 1000 or fewer KV keys before bulk deleting
kv.deleted: Deleted {count} KV key | Deleted {count} KV keys
kv.cleared: KV namespace and server cache cleared successfully
kv.clear_failed: Failed to clear KV and server cache
kv.select_all: Select all KV keys on this page
kv.json_hint: JSON mode validates and formats the current value.
kv.raw_hint: Raw mode saves the value exactly as text.
kv.editor_unavailable: Unable to load the editor. Falling back to a plain textarea.
kv.key_size: KV key must be 512 bytes or less
kv.value_size: KV value must be 25 MiB or less
kv.key_missing: This KV key no longer exists.
kv.temporary_auth_challenge: Short-lived WebAuthn challenge. Editing or deleting it can break an in-progress sign-in or passkey flow.
